translations.idiomatic: From the time the Huihe first came to China they usually brought Nine Surnames Hu with them. Many stayed on in the capital—sometimes as many as a thousand—and grew very rich.

sentences.zh: 會酋長突董、翳蜜施、大小梅錄等還國，裝橐系道，留振武三月，供擬珍豐，費不貲。

translations.literal: When the chieftains Tudong, Yimishi, and the great and small Meilu were returning home, their baggage lined the roads. They remained at Zhenwu three months; provisions were rare and sumptuous, and the expense was beyond reckoning.
translations.idiomatic: When the chieftains Tudong, Yimishi, and the great and small Meilu returned home, their baggage trains filled the roads. They lingered at Zhenwu three months on lavish provisions at ruinous expense.

sentences.zh: 軍使張光晟陰伺之，皆盛女子以橐，光晟使驛吏刺以長錐，然後知之。

translations.literal: Army commander Zhang Guangcheng watched them in secret. They all had women packed in their bags. Guangcheng had relay clerks pierce them with long awls, and only then knew it.
translations.idiomatic: Army commander Zhang Guangcheng watched them secretly. They had packed women into their baggage. He had relay clerks pierce the sacks with long awls and only then discovered it.

sentences.zh: 已而聞頓莫賀新立，多殺九姓胡人，懼不敢歸，往往亡去，突董察視嚴亟。

translations.literal: Before long they heard Dun Moyancho had newly taken the throne and had killed many Nine Surnames Hu. Fearful, they dared not return; many fled. Tudong kept strict watch.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they heard Dun Moyancho had seized power and slaughtered many Nine Surnames Hu. Afraid to return, many fled. Tudong kept them under tight guard.

sentences.zh: 群胡獻計於光晟，請悉斬回紇，光晟許之，即上言：「回紇非素強，助之者九胡爾。

translations.literal: The Hu as a group presented a plan to Guangcheng, asking to kill all the Huihe outright. Guangcheng agreed and memorialized: "The Huihe are not strong by nature; those who help them are the Nine Hu.
translations.idiomatic: The Hu collectively urged Guangcheng to kill every Huihe at once. He agreed and memorialized, "The Huihe are not strong in themselves; the Nine Hu are what make them formidable.

sentences.zh: 今其國亂，兵方相加，而虜利則往，財則合，無財與利，一亂不振。

translations.literal: Now their state is in disorder and their armies are fighting one another. When the barbarians see profit they go; when they see wealth they unite. Without wealth or profit they cannot rally in chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Now their realm is in turmoil and their armies are fighting one another. When they see profit they march; when they see wealth they unite. Without wealth or profit they cannot hold together in chaos.

sentences.zh: 不以此時乘之，復歸人與幣，是謂借賊兵，資盜糧也。」

translations.literal: If we do not strike at this moment but again return men and coin, this is called lending weapons to the bandit and feeding grain to the thief.
translations.idiomatic: If we do not strike now but again give them men and money, we will be lending arms to bandits and feeding grain to thieves.

sentences.zh: 乃使裨校陽不禮，突董果怒，鞭之。

translations.literal: He then sent the lieutenant Yang Buli. Tudong was indeed enraged and flogged him.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the lieutenant Yang Buli. Tudong was enraged and had him flogged.

sentences.zh: 光晟因勒兵盡殺回紇群胡，收橐它、馬數千，繒錦十萬，且告曰：「回紇抶大將，謀取振武，謹先誅之。」

translations.literal: Guangcheng thereupon led his troops and killed all the Huihe and Hu in the group, seizing several thousand camels and horses and a hundred thousand bolts of silks and brocades, and reporting: "The Huihe flogged a great general and plotted to seize Zhenwu; I have therefore executed them first.
translations.idiomatic: Guangcheng then led his troops and slaughtered every Huihe and Hu in the party, seizing thousands of camels and horses and a hundred thousand bolts of silks and brocades. He reported, "The Huihe beat a senior commander and plotted to take Zhenwu, so I have executed them first.

sentences.zh: 部送女子還長安。

translations.literal: He escorted the women back to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He sent the women back to Chang'an under guard.

sentences.zh: 帝召光晟還，以彭令方代之，遣中人與回紇使聿達干往言其端，因欲與虜絕。

translations.literal: The emperor recalled Guangcheng and replaced him with Peng Lingfang, sent an eunuch with the Huihe envoy Lü Dagan to explain the affair, and intended to break with the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor recalled Guangcheng, installed Peng Lingfang in his place, and sent an eunuch with the Huihe envoy Lü Dagan to explain what had happened, intending to sever relations with the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 敕源休俟命太原。

translations.literal: He ordered Yuan Xiu to await orders at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered Yuan Xiu to remain at Taiyuan awaiting instructions.

sentences.zh: 明年，乃行，因歸突董等四喪。

translations.literal: The next year he then departed, returning the four coffins of Tudong and the others.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he set out, escorting home the four coffins of Tudong and the others.

sentences.zh: 突董，可汗諸父也。

translations.literal: Tudong was an uncle of the qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: Tudong was a paternal uncle of the qaghan.

sentences.zh: 源休至，可汗令大臣具車馬出迎，其大相頡幹迦斯踞坐責休等殺突董事，休言：「彼自與張光晟鬥死，非天子命。」

translations.literal: When Yuan Xiu arrived, the qaghan ordered the ministers to prepare carriages and horses to welcome him. The great chancellor Xiegan Jiasi sat cross-legged and reproached Xiu and the others for killing Tudong. Xiu said: "They died fighting Zhang Guangcheng on their own—it was not the Son of Heaven's command.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuan Xiu arrived, the qaghan ordered his ministers to ready carriages and horses to welcome him. The great chancellor Xiegan Jiasi sat cross-legged and rebuked Xiu and his party for killing Tudong. Xiu said, "They died fighting Zhang Guangcheng on their own—it was not on the Son of Heaven's orders.

sentences.zh: 又曰：「使者皆負死罪，唐不自戮，何假手於我邪？」

translations.literal: He also said: "The envoys all bear capital guilt. If Tang will not execute them itself, why borrow our hand?"
translations.idiomatic: He also said, "Your envoys are all guilty of capital crimes. If Tang will not put them to death itself, why use our hand?"

sentences.zh: 良久罷去，休等幾死。

translations.literal: After a long while he dismissed them. Xiu and the others nearly died.
translations.idiomatic: After a long while he let them go. Xiu and the others came close to death.

sentences.zh: 留五旬，卒不見可汗。

translations.literal: They remained fifty days and ultimately never saw the qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: They stayed fifty days and in the end never saw the qaghan.

sentences.zh: 可汗傳謂休曰：「國人皆欲爾死，我獨不然。

translations.literal: The qaghan sent word to Xiu: "Our people all want you dead; I alone do not.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan sent word to Xiu, "All my people want you dead; I alone do not.

sentences.zh: 突董等已亡，今又殺爾，猶以血濯血，徒益汙。

translations.literal: Tudong and the others are already gone. To kill you now would be washing blood with blood—it would only add defilement.
translations.idiomatic: Tudong and the others are already dead. To kill you now would be washing blood with blood and would only add to the stain.

sentences.zh: 吾以水濯血，不亦善乎？

translations.literal: To wash blood with water—is that not better?
translations.idiomatic: To wash blood with water—would that not be better?

sentences.zh: 為我言有司，所負馬直一百八十萬，可速償我。」

translations.literal: Tell the authorities for me: the horse price owed is 1.8 million—repay me quickly.
translations.idiomatic: Tell the authorities for me that the horse price owed is 1.8 million and that they should repay me at once.

sentences.zh: 遣散支將軍康赤心等隨休來朝。

translations.literal: He sent General Kang Chixin of the Sanzhi branch and others to follow Xiu to court.
translations.idiomatic: He sent General Kang Chixin of the Sanzhi branch and others to accompany Xiu to court.

sentences.zh: 帝隱忍，賜以金繒。

translations.literal: The emperor restrained himself and bestowed gold and silks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor swallowed his anger and bestowed gold and silks on them.

sentences.zh: 後三年，使使者獻方物，請和親。

translations.literal: Three years later they sent envoys presenting local goods and requesting a marriage alliance.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later they sent envoys with tribute and a request for a marriage alliance.

sentences.zh: 帝蓄前恚未平，謂宰相李泌曰：「和親待子孫圖之，朕不能已。」

translations.literal: The emperor nursed his earlier anger, which had not subsided, and said to Chief Minister Li Mi: "Marriage alliance—let posterity plan it. I cannot acquiesce now.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor still nursed his old grievance and said to Chief Minister Li Mi, "Let posterity plan a marriage alliance. I cannot agree to one now.

sentences.zh: 泌曰：「陛下豈以陜州故憾乎？」

translations.literal: Li Mi said: "Does Your Majesty still resent what happened at Shanzhou?"
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi said, "Does Your Majesty still resent what happened at Shanzhou?"

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「然。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Yes.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Yes.

sentences.zh: 朕方天下多難，未能報，且毋議和。」

translations.literal: I am amid many difficulties in the realm and cannot yet repay them. For now do not discuss peace."
translations.idiomatic: The realm is still in many troubles and I cannot yet settle the score. For now do not discuss peace."

sentences.zh: 泌曰：「辱少華等乃牟羽可汗也，知陛下即位必償怨，乃謀先苦邊，然兵未出，為今可汗所殺矣。

translations.literal: Li Mi said: "The humiliation of Shaohua and the others was the work of Qaghan Moyu. Knowing Your Majesty would surely exact revenge when you took the throne, he plotted first to harry the frontier—but before his troops marched out, the present qaghan killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi said, "The humiliation of Shaohua and the others was the doing of Qaghan Moyu. Knowing that when Your Majesty took the throne you would surely exact revenge, he plotted first to harry the frontier—but before his troops could march, the present qaghan killed him.

sentences.zh: 今可汗初立，遣使來告，垂髮不翦，待天子命。

translations.literal: The present qaghan has only just succeeded. He sent envoys to announce it, leaving his hair uncut, awaiting the Son of Heaven's command.
translations.idiomatic: The present qaghan has only just succeeded. He sent envoys to announce his accession, leaving his hair uncut until he received the Son of Heaven's command.

sentences.zh: 而張光晟殺突董等。

translations.literal: Yet Zhang Guangcheng killed Tudong and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Zhang Guangcheng killed Tudong and the others.

sentences.zh: 雖幽止使人，然卒完歸，則為無罪矣。」

translations.literal: Though the envoys were confined, they returned safe and whole in the end—so there is no guilt.
translations.idiomatic: Although the envoys were detained, they returned safe and whole in the end—so Tang is not guilty.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「卿言則然，顧朕不可負少華等，奈何？」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "What you say is so—but I cannot fail Shaohua and the others. What then?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "What you say is true, but I cannot fail Shaohua and the others. What then?"

sentences.zh: 泌曰：「臣謂陛下不負少華，少華負陛下。

translations.literal: Li Mi said: "I hold that Your Majesty did not fail Shaohua—Shaohua failed Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: Li Mi said, "I would say Your Majesty did not fail Shaohua—Shaohua failed Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 且北虜君長身赴難，陛下在藩，春秋未壯，而輕度河入其營，所謂冒豺虎之場也。

translations.literal: Moreover, when the northern chieftains came in person to aid in the crisis, Your Majesty was still prince, not yet of full years, yet you lightly crossed the river and entered their camp—the so-called walking into a den of wolves and tigers.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the northern chieftains came in person to aid in the crisis, Your Majesty was still crown prince and not yet fully grown, yet you lightly crossed the river and entered their camp—what people call walking into a den of wolves and tigers.

sentences.zh: 為少華等計，當先定會見禮，臣猶危之，奈何孑然赴哉？

translations.literal: For Shaohua and the others to have planned, they should first have settled the ceremony for meeting you. I would still have considered that dangerous—how could you go alone?
translations.idiomatic: On Shaohua's plan, they should first have fixed the ceremony for your meeting. I would still have thought that dangerous—how could you go alone?

sentences.zh: 臣昔為先帝行軍司馬，方葉護來，先帝祗使宴於府。

translations.literal: I once served the late emperor as army march secretary. When Yehu came, the late emperor merely had him feasted at the princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: I once served the late emperor as army march secretary. When Yehu came, the late emperor merely had him entertained at the princely residence.

sentences.zh: 及議征討，則不見也。

translations.literal: When military matters were discussed, he was not received.
translations.idiomatic: When military affairs were discussed, he was not received.

sentences.zh: 葉護邀臣至營，帝不許，使好謂曰：『主當勞客，客返勞主邪？』

translations.literal: Yehu invited me to his camp. The emperor would not permit it and sent a courteous message: "The host should entertain the guest—should the guest turn and entertain the host?"
translations.idiomatic: Yehu invited me to his camp. The emperor would not allow it and sent a courteous message: "The host should entertain the guest—should the guest turn and entertain the host?"

sentences.zh: 東收京師，約曰：『土地、人眾歸我，玉帛、子女予回紇。』

translations.literal: When we advanced east to recover the capital, the agreement was: "Land and people are ours; silks and women go to the Huihe."
translations.idiomatic: When we marched east to recover the capital, the agreement was: "Land and people are ours; silks and women go to the Huihe."

sentences.zh: 戰勝，葉護欲大掠，代宗下馬拜之，回紇乃東向洛。

translations.literal: After victory Yehu wanted to plunder on a grand scale. Emperor Daizong dismounted and bowed to him, and the Huihe then turned east toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: After victory Yehu wanted to plunder on a grand scale. Emperor Daizong dismounted and bowed to him, and the Huihe then turned east toward Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 臣猶恨以元帥拜葉護於馬前，為左右過，然先帝曰：『王仁孝，足辦朕事。』

translations.literal: I still regret that the commander-in-chief bowed to Yehu before his horse—that was an error of those around him. Yet the late emperor said: "The prince is filial and dutiful; he can accomplish my affairs."
translations.idiomatic: I still regret that the commander-in-chief bowed to Yehu from horseback—that was a mistake of those around him. Yet the late emperor said, "The prince is filial and capable; he can accomplish my affairs."

sentences.zh: 下詔尉勉。

translations.literal: An edict was issued to console and encourage him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict was issued to console and encourage him.

sentences.zh: 葉護乃牟羽諸父也，牟羽之來，陛下以元子不拜於帳下，而可汗不敢少有失於陛下，則陛下未嘗屈矣。

translations.literal: Yehu was Moyu's paternal uncle. When Moyu came, Your Majesty as eldest son did not bow beneath his tent—and the qaghan dared not show the slightest disrespect toward Your Majesty. Thus Your Majesty never humbled yourself.
translations.idiomatic: Yehu was Moyu's paternal uncle. When Moyu came, Your Majesty as eldest son did not bow beneath his tent—and the qaghan dared not show the slightest disrespect toward Your Majesty. Thus Your Majesty never humbled yourself.

sentences.zh: 先帝拜葉護，全京城，陛下乃不拜可汗，固伸威於虜，何恨焉？

translations.literal: The late emperor bowed to Yehu and preserved the capital. Your Majesty did not bow to the qaghan—you asserted prestige over the barbarians firmly. What resentment is there?
translations.idiomatic: The late emperor bowed to Yehu and saved the capital. Your Majesty did not bow to the qaghan—you firmly asserted prestige over the barbarians. What is there to resent?

sentences.zh: 然計香積、陜州事，以屈己為是乎？

translations.literal: Yet considering Xiangji and Shanzhou—was humbling yourself right?
translations.idiomatic: Yet when you weigh Xiangji and Shanzhou—was humbling yourself right?

sentences.zh: 伸威為是乎？

translations.literal: Or was asserting prestige right?
translations.idiomatic: Or was asserting prestige right?

sentences.zh: 藉令少華等以陛下見可汗，閉壁五日，與陛下張飲，天下豈不寒心哉？

translations.literal: Suppose Shaohua and the others had brought Your Majesty to see the qaghan, shut you in for five days, and feasted with you lavishly—would not the realm have been chilled to the heart?
translations.idiomatic: Suppose Shaohua and the others had brought Your Majesty to see the qaghan, shut you in for five days, and feasted with you lavishly—would not the whole realm have been chilled to the heart?

sentences.zh: 而天助威神，使豺狼馴服，牟羽母捧陛下以貂裘，叱左右促命騎，躬送出營。

translations.literal: Yet Heaven aided with awesome spirit and made wolves and tigers submit. Moyu's mother wrapped Your Majesty in a sable coat, rebuked attendants to hurry the horse, and personally escorted you out of camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Heaven aided with its awesome spirit and made wolves and tigers submit. Moyu's mother wrapped Your Majesty in a sable coat, rebuked the attendants to hurry the horse, and personally escorted you out of camp.

sentences.zh: 此少華等負陛下也。

translations.literal: This was Shaohua and the others failing Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: That was Shaohua and the others failing Your Majesty.

sentences.zh: 假令牟羽為有罪，則今可汗已殺之，立者乃牟羽從父兄，是為有功，渠可忘之邪？

translations.literal: Even if Moyu were guilty, the present qaghan has already killed him. The one enthroned is Moyu's younger cousin on the paternal line—that is merit. How can it be forgotten?
translations.idiomatic: Even if Moyu were guilty, the present qaghan has already killed him. The one enthroned is Moyu's younger cousin on the paternal line—that is a service. How can that be forgotten?

sentences.zh: 且回紇可汗銘石立國門曰：『唐使來，當使知我前後功』云。

translations.literal: Moreover the Huihe qaghan inscribed stone at the state gate: "When Tang envoys come, let them know our former and latter services."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Huihe qaghan set up an inscribed stone at the state gate: "When Tang envoys come, let them know our services past and present."

sentences.zh: 今請和，必舉部南望，陛下不之答，其怨必深。

translations.literal: Now they seek peace—they will surely rally the tribes to look south. If Your Majesty does not answer, their resentment will surely run deep.
translations.idiomatic: Now they seek peace and will surely rally the tribes to look south. If Your Majesty does not answer, their resentment will surely run deep.

sentences.zh: 願聽昏而約用開元故事，如突厥可汗稱臣，使來者不過二百，市馬不過千，不以唐人出塞，亦無不可者。」

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would heed this in your wisdom and covenant by the Kaiyuan precedent—like the Turk qaghans submitting as subjects, envoys not exceeding two hundred, horse purchases not exceeding one thousand, and no Tang people crossing the frontier—none of which would be impossible."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that Your Majesty heed this in your wisdom and covenant by the Kaiyuan precedent—like the Turk qaghans submitting as subjects, envoys not exceeding two hundred, horse purchases not exceeding one thousand, and no Tang people crossing the frontier—none of which would be impossible."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「善。」

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Good."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "Good."

sentences.zh: 乃許降公主，回紇亦請如約。

translations.literal: He then agreed to send down a princess in marriage. The Huihe also asked to follow the agreement."
translations.idiomatic: He then agreed to send a princess down in marriage. The Huihe also asked to follow the agreement."

sentences.zh: 詔咸安公主下嫁，又詔使者合闕達干見公主於麟德殿，使中謁者賫公主畫圖賜可汗。

translations.literal: An edict sent Princess Xian'an down in marriage. Another edict had envoy Heque Dagan see the princess at Qinde Hall and sent a palace attendant bearing the princess's portrait to bestow on the qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Princess Xian'an down in marriage. Another edict had the envoy Heque Dagan see the princess at Qinde Hall and sent a palace attendant bearing the princess's portrait as a gift for the qaghan.

sentences.zh: 明年，可汗遣宰相跌都督等眾千餘，並遣其妹骨咄祿毗伽公主率大酋之妻五十人逆主，且納聘。

translations.literal: The next year the qaghan sent Chancellor Die Dudou and more than a thousand others, also sending his younger sister Princess Gutuolu Pijia at the head of fifty wives of great chieftains to meet the bride and present betrothal gifts.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the qaghan sent Chancellor Die Dudou with more than a thousand followers, and also sent his younger sister Princess Gutuolu Pijia leading fifty wives of great chieftains to meet the bride and present betrothal gifts.

sentences.zh: 跌至振武，為室韋所鈔，戰死。

translations.literal: Die reached Zhenwu, was waylaid by the Shiwei, and died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: Die reached Zhenwu, was ambushed by the Shiwei, and died in battle.

sentences.zh: 有詔其下七百，皆聽入朝，舍鴻臚，帝御延喜門見使者。

translations.literal: An edict allowed seven hundred of his followers to enter court. They lodged at the Honglu Temple. The emperor received the envoys at the Yanchi Gate.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed seven hundred of his followers to enter court. They lodged at the Honglu Temple while the emperor received the envoys at the Yanchi Gate.

sentences.zh: 是時，可汗上書恭甚，言：「昔為兄弟，今婿，半子也。

translations.literal: At this time the qaghan's memorial was very respectful, saying: "Formerly we were brothers; now I am son-in-law—a half-son.
translations.idiomatic: At this time the qaghan's memorial was very respectful, saying, "Formerly we were brothers; now I am son-in-law—a half-son.

sentences.zh: 陛下若患西戎，子請以兵除之。」

translations.literal: If Your Majesty worries over the western tribes, your son asks to remove them with troops.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty is troubled by the western tribes, your son asks to remove them with troops.

sentences.zh: 又請易回紇曰回鶻，言捷鷙猶鶻然。

translations.literal: He also asked to change Huihe to Uyghur, saying they were swift and fierce like hawks."
translations.idiomatic: He also asked to change Huihe to Uyghur, saying they were swift and fierce like hawks."

sentences.zh: 帝欲饗回鶻公主，問禮於李泌，對曰：「肅宗於敦煌王為從祖兄，回鶻妻以女，見帝於彭原，獨拜廷下，帝呼曰『婦』而不名『嫂』也。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to feast the Uyghur princess and asked Li Mi about ceremony. He replied: "Emperor Suzong was a cousin once removed to the Prince of Dunhuang. The Uyghurs married him a daughter. When she saw the emperor at Pengyuan she alone bowed in the hall. The emperor called her 'daughter-in-law,' not 'sister-in-law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to feast the Uyghur princess and asked Li Mi about the ceremony. He replied, "Emperor Suzong was a cousin once removed to the Prince of Dunhuang. The Uyghurs married him a daughter. When she saw the emperor at Pengyuan she alone bowed in the hall. The emperor called her 'daughter-in-law,' not 'sister-in-law.

sentences.zh: 當艱虞時，方藉其用，猶以臣之，況今日乎？」

translations.literal: In those dire days we still needed their help and treated her as a subject—how much more today?'
translations.idiomatic: In those dire days we still needed their help and treated her as a subject—how much more so today?'

sentences.zh: 於是引回鶻公主入銀臺門，長公主三人候諸內，譯史傳導，拜必答，揖與進。

translations.literal: They then led the Uyghur princess in through the Yintai Gate. Three senior princesses waited inside. Interpreters conducted her; every bow received a reply, and they advanced with mutual bows."
translations.idiomatic: They then led the Uyghur princess in through the Yintai Gate. Three senior princesses waited inside. Interpreters guided her; every bow received a reply, and they advanced with mutual bows.

sentences.zh: 帝御秘殿，長公主先入侍，回鶻公主入，拜謁已，內司賓導至長公主所，又譯史傳問，乃與俱入。

translations.literal: The emperor sat in the secret hall. The senior princesses entered first to attend him. After the Uyghur princess entered and performed her obeisance, the inner chamberlain of guests led her to where the senior princesses were; interpreters again conveyed questions, and they entered together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sat in the secret hall. The senior princesses entered first to attend him. After the Uyghur princess entered and performed her obeisance, the inner chamberlain of guests led her to the senior princesses; interpreters again conveyed questions, and they entered together.

sentences.zh: 至宴所，賢妃降階俟，回鶻公主拜，賢妃答拜。

translations.literal: At the banquet place the Honored Consort descended the steps to await her. The Uyghur princess bowed; the Honored Consort returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: At the banquet hall the Honored Consort descended the steps to await her. The Uyghur princess bowed, and the Honored Consort returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 又拜召已，由西階升，乃坐。

translations.literal: After being summoned with another bow, she ascended by the western steps and then sat.
translations.idiomatic: After another bow at the summons, she ascended by the western steps and then sat.

sentences.zh: 有賜則降拜，非帝賜則避席拜，妃、公主皆答拜。

translations.literal: When gifts were given she descended to bow; for gifts not from the emperor she left her seat to bow. The consort and princesses all returned the bows.
translations.idiomatic: When gifts were given she descended to bow; for gifts not from the emperor she left her seat to bow. The consort and princesses all returned the bows.

sentences.zh: 訖歸，凡再饗。

translations.literal: When she returned, she was feasted twice in all.
translations.idiomatic: Before she departed, she was feasted twice in all.

sentences.zh: 帝又盡建咸安公主官屬，視王府。

translations.literal: The emperor also fully established Princess Xian'an's staff, on the model of a princely residence.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also fully established Princess Xian'an's staff on the model of a princely household.

sentences.zh: 以嗣滕王湛然為昏禮使，右僕射關播護送，且將冊書拜可汗為汩咄祿長壽天親毗伽可汗，公主為智惠端正長壽孝順可敦。

translations.literal: He made Heir Apparent Prince of Teng Zhanran marriage-rites commissioner, with Right Vice Director Guan Bo as escort, bearing the investiture documents to invest the qaghan as Qaghan Gutuolu Changshou Tianqin Pijia and the princess as Khatun Zhihui Duanzheng Changshou Xiaoshun.
translations.idiomatic: He made Heir Apparent Prince of Teng Zhanran marriage-rites commissioner and Right Vice Director Guan Bo escort, bearing investiture documents to invest the qaghan as Qaghan Gutuolu Changshou Tianqin Pijia and the princess as Khatun Zhihui Duanzheng Changshou Xiaoshun.

sentences.zh: ，可汗死，子多邏斯立，國人號「泮官特勒」，以鴻臚卿郭鋒持節冊拜愛登里邏汩沒蜜施俱錄毗伽忠貞可汗。

translations.literal: The qaghan died. His son Duoluo Si succeeded; the people called him "Panguan Tegin." The Minister of Honglu Guo Feng was sent with credentials to invest him as Qaghan Aidengli Luogu Meimishi Julu Pijia Zhongzhen.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan died. His son Duoluo Si succeeded, and the people called him "Panguan Tegin." Minister of Honglu Guo Feng was sent with credentials to invest him as Qaghan Aidengli Luogu Meimishi Julu Pijia Zhongzhen.

sentences.zh: 初，安西、北庭自天寶末失關、隴，朝貢道隔。

translations.literal: At first, Anxi and Beiting since the end of the Tianbao era had lost contact through Guan and Long; the tribute route was severed.
translations.idiomatic: At first, since the end of the Tianbao era Anxi and Beiting had lost contact through Guan and Long, and the tribute route was cut off.

sentences.zh: 伊西北庭節度使李元忠、四鎮節度留後郭昕數遣使奉表，皆不至。

translations.literal: Li Yuanzhong, military commissioner of Yixin and Beiting, and Guo Xin, regent of the Four Garrisons, repeatedly sent envoys with memorials, but none arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yuanzhong, military commissioner of Yixin and Beiting, and Guo Xin, regent of the Four Garrisons, repeatedly sent envoys with memorials, but none reached court.

sentences.zh: ，元忠等所遣假道回鶻，乃得至長安。

translations.literal: Those sent by Yuanzhong and the others went by way of the Uyghurs and thus reached Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Those sent by Yuanzhong and the others traveled by way of the Uyghurs and thus reached Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 帝進元忠為北庭大都護，昕為安西大都護。

translations.literal: The emperor promoted Yuanzhong to Grand Protector-General of Beiting and Xin to Grand Protector-General of Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor promoted Yuanzhong to Grand Protector-General of Beiting and Xin to Grand Protector-General of Anxi.

sentences.zh: 自是，道雖通，而虜求取無涘。

translations.literal: From then on the route was open, but the barbarians' demands were endless.
translations.idiomatic: From then on the route was open, but the barbarians' demands were endless.

sentences.zh: 沙陀別部六千帳，與北庭相依，亦厭虜裒索，至三葛祿、白眼突厥素臣回鶻者尤怨苦，皆密附吐蕃，故吐蕃因沙陀共寇北庭，頡幹迦斯與戰，不勝，北庭陷。

translations.literal: Six thousand households of the Shatuo collateral branch, relying on Beiting, also wearied of the barbarians' extortion. The Three Qarlugs and the White-Eyed Turks who had long submitted to the Uyghurs were especially embittered—all secretly attached themselves to Tibet. Thus Tibet joined with the Shatuo to raid Beiting together. Xiegan Jiasi fought them but was defeated, and Beiting fell.
translations.idiomatic: Six thousand households of the Shatuo collateral branch, relying on Beiting, also wearied of the barbarians' extortion. The Three Qarlugs and the White-Eyed Turks who had long submitted to the Uyghurs were especially embittered, and all secretly attached themselves to Tibet. Tibet therefore joined with the Shatuo to attack Beiting together. Xiegan Jiasi fought them but was defeated, and Beiting fell.

sentences.zh: 於是都護楊襲古引兵奔西州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Protector-General Yang Xigu led his troops in flight to Xizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Protector-General Yang Xigu led his troops in flight to Xizhou.

sentences.zh: 回鶻以壯卒數萬召襲古，將還取北庭，為吐蕃所擊，大敗，士死太半，迦斯奔還。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs summoned Xigu with tens of thousands of stalwart warriors to recover Beiting. They were struck by Tibet and suffered a great defeat; more than half the soldiers died, and Jiasi fled back.
translations.idiomatic: The Uyghurs summoned Xigu with tens of thousands of stalwart warriors to recover Beiting. Tibet struck them and they suffered a great defeat; more than half the soldiers died, and Jiasi fled back.

sentences.zh: 襲古挈餘眾將入西州，迦斯紿曰：「弟與我俱歸，當使公還唐。」

translations.literal: Xigu took the remaining force and was about to enter Xizhou. Jiasi deceived him, saying: "Younger brother, come home with me and I will have you return to Tang.
translations.idiomatic: Xigu took the survivors and was about to enter Xizhou. Jiasi deceived him, saying, "Younger brother, come home with me and I will have you return to Tang.

sentences.zh: 襲古至帳，殺之。

translations.literal: When Xigu reached the tent, they killed him.
translations.idiomatic: When Xigu reached the tent, they killed him.

sentences.zh: 葛祿又取深圖川，回鶻大恐，稍南其部落以避之。

translations.literal: The Qarlugs also took the Deep Tufu River region. The Uyghurs were greatly afraid and gradually shifted their tribes southward to avoid them.
translations.idiomatic: The Qarlugs also took the Deep Tufu River region. The Uyghurs were greatly afraid and gradually shifted their tribes southward to avoid them.

sentences.zh: 是歲，可汗為少可敦葉公主所毒死，可敦亦仆固懷恩之孫，懷恩子為回鶻葉護，故女號葉公主云。

translations.literal: That year the qaghan was poisoned to death by the junior khatun, Princess Ye. The khatun was also a granddaughter of Pugu Huai'en—Huai'en's son had been Uyghur yabghu, so the daughter was styled Princess Ye.
translations.idiomatic: That year the qaghan was poisoned to death by the junior khatun, Princess Ye. The khatun was also a granddaughter of Pugu Huai'en; Huai'en's son had been Uyghur yabghu, so the daughter was styled Princess Ye.

sentences.zh: 可汗之弟乃自立。

translations.literal: The qaghan's younger brother thereupon enthroned himself.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan's younger brother thereupon enthroned himself.

sentences.zh: 迦斯方攻吐蕃，其大臣率國人共殺篡者，以可汗幼子阿啜嗣。

translations.literal: Jiasi was then attacking Tibet. The ministers led the people together to kill the usurper and enthroned the qaghan's young son A Chuo.
translations.idiomatic: Jiasi was then attacking Tibet. The ministers led the people together to kill the usurper and enthroned the qaghan's young son A Chuo.

sentences.zh: 迦斯還，可汗等出勞，皆俯伏言廢立狀，惟大相生死之。

translations.literal: When Jiasi returned, the qaghan and others came out to welcome him. All prostrated themselves and reported the deposition and enthronement, leaving the great chancellor's life and death to him alone.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiasi returned, the qaghan and others came out to welcome him. All prostrated themselves and reported the deposition and enthronement, leaving the great chancellor's life and death to him alone.

sentences.zh: 悉發郭鋒所賜器幣餉迦斯。

translations.literal: They fully sent out the vessels and silks Guo Feng had bestowed to provision Jiasi.
translations.idiomatic: They sent out in full the vessels and silks Guo Feng had bestowed to provision Jiasi.

sentences.zh: 可汗拜且泣曰：「今幸得繼絕，仰食於父也。」

translations.literal: The qaghan bowed and wept, saying: "Now we are fortunate to continue the line—I eat by relying on a father.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan bowed and wept, saying, "Now we are fortunate to continue the line—I live by relying on a father.

sentences.zh: 迦斯以其柔屈，乃相持哭，遂臣事之，以器幣悉給將士，無所私，其國遂安。

translations.literal: Jiasi, moved by his meek submission, held him and wept together, then served him as subject. He gave all the vessels and silks to the officers and men and kept nothing for himself, and the state was thereafter at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Jiasi, moved by his meek submission, embraced him and wept together, then served him as subject. He gave all the vessels and silks to the officers and men and kept nothing for himself, and the state was thereafter at peace.

sentences.zh: 遣達北特勒梅錄將軍來告，且聽命。

translations.literal: He sent Dabei Tegin General Meilu to report and to take orders.
translations.idiomatic: He sent Dabei Tegin General Meilu to report and to await orders.

sentences.zh: 詔鴻臚少卿庾鋋冊阿啜為奉誠可汗。

translations.literal: An edict commissioned Vice Minister of Honglu Yu Shen to invest A Chuo as Qaghan Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: An edict commissioned Vice Minister of Honglu Yu Shen to invest A Chuo as Qaghan Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 俄以律支達干來告少寧國公主之喪。

translations.literal: Soon Luzhi Dagan came to announce the death of the junior Ningguo Princess.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Luzhi Dagan came to announce the death of the junior Ningguo Princess.

sentences.zh: 主，榮王女也。

translations.literal: The princess was a daughter of the Prince of Rong.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was a daughter of the Prince of Rong.

sentences.zh: 始寧國下嫁，又以媵之。

translations.literal: When Ningguo was first sent down in marriage, she was also given as a secondary bride.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningguo was first sent down in marriage, she was also given as a secondary bride.

sentences.zh: 寧國後歸，因留回鶻中為可敦，號「少寧國」，歷配英武、英義二可汗。

translations.literal: After Ningguo later returned, she remained among the Uyghurs as khatun, styled "Junior Ningguo," and successively wed the Yingwu and Yingyi qaghans.
translations.idiomatic: After Ningguo later returned, she remained among the Uyghurs as khatun, styled "Junior Ningguo," and successively wed the Yingwu and Yingyi qaghans.

sentences.zh: 至天親可汗時，始居外。

translations.literal: Only under Qaghan Tianqin did she begin to live outside.
translations.idiomatic: Only under Qaghan Tianqin did she begin to live outside the camp.

sentences.zh: 其配英義生二子，皆為天親所殺。

translations.literal: She bore two sons to the Yingyi qaghan, and both were killed by Tianqin.
translations.idiomatic: She bore two sons to the Yingyi qaghan, and both were killed by Tianqin.

sentences.zh: 是歲，回鶻擊吐蕃、葛祿於北庭，勝之，且獻俘。

translations.literal: That year the Uyghurs attacked Tibet and the Qarlugs at Beiting, defeated them, and presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Uyghurs attacked Tibet and the Qarlugs at Beiting, defeated them, and presented captives.

sentences.zh: 明年，使藥羅葛炅來朝，炅本唐人呂氏，為可汗養子，遂從可汗姓。

translations.literal: The next year they sent Yaoluoge Jiong to court. Jiong was originally of the Tang Lü clan; adopted as the qaghan's son, he then took the qaghan's surname.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they sent Yaoluoge Jiong to court. Jiong was originally of the Tang Lü clan; adopted as the qaghan's son, he then took the qaghan's surname.

sentences.zh: 帝以其用事，賜賫殊優，拜檢校尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: The emperor, because he wielded power, bestowed gifts of exceptional generosity and appointed him Acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Because he wielded power, the emperor bestowed gifts of exceptional generosity and appointed him Acting Right Vice Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一年，可汗死，無子，國人立其相骨咄祿為可汗，以使者來，詔秘書監張薦持節冊拜愛滕里邏羽錄沒蜜施合胡祿毗伽懷信可汗。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year the qaghan died without a son. The people enthroned his chancellor Gutuolu as qaghan. When envoys came, an edict commissioned Director of the Secretariat Zhang Jian with credentials to invest him as Qaghan Aitengli Luoyulu Meimishi Hehulu Pijia Huaixin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year the qaghan died without a son. The people enthroned his chancellor Gutuolu as qaghan. When envoys came, an edict commissioned Director of the Secretariat Zhang Jian with credentials to invest him as Qaghan Aitengli Luoyulu Meimishi Hehulu Pijia Huaixin.

sentences.zh: 骨咄祿本跌氏，少孤，為大首領所養，辯敏材武，當天親時數主兵，諸酋尊畏。

translations.literal: Gutuolu was originally of the Die clan, orphaned young and raised by a great chieftain. Clever, eloquent, and martial, under Tianqin he often commanded troops and all chieftains revered and feared him.
translations.idiomatic: Gutuolu was originally of the Die clan. Orphaned young, he was raised by a great chieftain. Clever, eloquent, and martial, under Tianqin he often commanded troops, and all chieftains revered and feared him.

sentences.zh: 至是，以藥羅葛氏世有功，不敢自名其族，而盡取可汗子孫內之朝廷。

translations.literal: At this point, because the Yaglakar clan had served with merit for generations, he dared not proclaim his own lineage, and instead sent all the qaghan's descendants into the Tang court.
translations.idiomatic: At this point, because the Yaglakar clan had served with merit for generations, he dared not proclaim his own lineage and instead sent all the qaghan's descendants into the Tang court.

sentences.zh: ，可汗死，詔鴻臚少卿孫杲臨吊，冊所嗣為滕里野合俱錄毗伽可汗。

translations.literal: The qaghan died. An edict sent Vice Minister of Honglu Sun Gao to mourn on the spot and invest the successor as Qaghan Tengliye He Julu Pijia.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan died. An edict sent Vice Minister of Honglu Sun Gao to mourn on the spot and invest the successor as Qaghan Tengliye He Julu Pijia.

sentences.zh: 元和初，再朝獻，始以摩尼至。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era they again came to court with tribute; Manichaeism arrived for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanhe era they again came to court with tribute, and Manichaeism arrived for the first time.

sentences.zh: 其法日晏食，飲水茹葷，屏湩酪，可汗常與共國者也。

translations.literal: Their practice was to eat one meal late in the day, drink water, and eat vegetables with meat, shunning fermented milk and dairy; the qaghan regularly shared meals with his people in this way.
translations.idiomatic: They ate one meal late in the day, drank water, ate vegetables with meat, and avoided fermented milk and dairy. The qaghan regularly ate in this manner together with his people.

sentences.zh: 摩尼至京師，歲往來西市，商賈頗與囊橐為奸。

translations.literal: When Mani reached the capital, he passed each year to and from the Western Market; merchants often joined in pouching profits through illicit dealings.
translations.idiomatic: When Manichaeism reached the capital, its followers traveled yearly to and from the Western Market, and merchants often profited through shady dealings with them.

sentences.zh: 三年，來告咸安公主喪。

translations.literal: In the third year they came to report Princess Xian'an's death.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year they came to announce the death of Princess Xian'an.

sentences.zh: 主歷四可汗，居回鶻凡二十一歲。

translations.literal: The princess had passed through four qaghans and lived among the Uyghurs for twenty-one years in all.
translations.idiomatic: The princess had served four qaghans and lived among the Uyghurs for twenty-one years in all.

sentences.zh: 無幾，可汗亦死，憲宗使宗正少卿李孝誠冊拜愛登里羅汨蜜施合毗伽保義可汗。

translations.literal: Before long the qaghan also died. Emperor Xianzong sent Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan Li Xiaocheng to invest Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Bilge Baoyi Qaghan by patent.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the qaghan died as well. Emperor Xianzong sent Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan Li Xiaocheng to invest Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Bilge Baoyi Qaghan with a patent of appointment.

sentences.zh: 閱三歲，使者再朝，遣伊難珠再請昏，未報。

translations.literal: After three years envoys came again to court; they sent Yinanzhu to request marriage once more, but no reply had been given.
translations.idiomatic: Three years later envoys came to court again. They sent Yinanzhu to request marriage once more, but received no answer.

sentences.zh: 可汗以三千騎至鸊鵜泉，於是振武以兵屯黑山，治天德城備虜。

translations.literal: The qaghan came to Lake Pili with three thousand horsemen. Thereupon Zhenwu stationed troops at Black Mountain and repaired Tiande city to guard against the barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan arrived at Lake Pili with three thousand horsemen. Zhenwu then stationed troops at Black Mountain and repaired Tiande city to guard against the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書李絳奏言：「回鶻盛強，北邊空虛，一為風塵，則弱卒非抗敵之夫，孤城為不守之地。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Li Jiang memorialized: "The Uyghurs are powerful and our northern frontier is empty. Once war-dust rises, weak soldiers will not suffice to resist the enemy, and lone fortresses will be places that cannot be held.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Li Jiang memorialized, "The Uyghurs are strong and our northern frontier is empty. Once fighting breaks out, weak soldiers will not be able to resist the enemy, and isolated cities will be indefensible.

sentences.zh: 儻陛下懷此，增甲兵，飭城壘，中夏長策，生人大幸也。

translations.literal: If Your Majesty keeps this in mind, increase armor and troops and repair walls and ramparts—a long-term policy for China, and great fortune for the people.
translations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty bears this in mind, increase armor and troops and repair walls and ramparts. That would be a lasting policy for China and great fortune for the people.

sentences.zh: 臣觀今日處置，未得其要。

translations.literal: Your servant observes that today's measures have not grasped the essentials.
translations.idiomatic: I see that the measures taken today have missed the point.

sentences.zh: 夫邊憂有五，請歷言之：北狄貪沒，唯利是視，比進馬規直，再歲不至，豈厭繒帛利哉？

translations.literal: Of frontier troubles there are five; allow me to recount them. The northern barbarians are greedy and covetous, looking only to profit. Lately when they presented horses to fix a price they did not come for two years—can they have tired of the profit in silks and damasks?
translations.idiomatic: There are five frontier worries, and I ask leave to list them. The northern barbarians are greedy and see only profit. Recently they brought horses to set a price but have not come for two years. Can they have grown tired of silk and brocade?

sentences.zh: 殆欲風高馬肥，而肆侵軼。

translations.literal: They are likely waiting until the winds are high and the horses fat to launch raids at will.
translations.idiomatic: They are probably waiting until the winds rise and the horses grow fat to raid at will.

sentences.zh: 故外攘內備，必煩朝廷，一可憂；

translations.literal: Thus outward defense and inward preparedness will surely burden the court—this is the first worry.
translations.idiomatic: Outward defense and inward preparedness will surely burden the court. That is the first worry.

sentences.zh: 兵力未完，斥侯未明，戈甲未備，城池未固，飾天德則虜必疑，虛西城則磧道無倚，二可憂；

translations.literal: Forces are not yet complete, scouts not yet alert, weapons and armor not yet ready, cities and walls not yet secure—if we embellish Tiande the barbarians will surely grow suspicious, while emptying the western cities leaves the desert road without support. This is the second worry.
translations.idiomatic: Forces are not yet ready, scouts not yet in place, arms and armor not yet stocked, and cities and walls not yet fortified. If we build up Tiande the barbarians will surely grow suspicious; if we leave the western cities empty the desert road will have no support. That is the second worry.

sentences.zh: 夫城保要害，攻守險易，當謀之邊將，今乃規河塞之外，裁廟堂之上，虜猝犯塞，應接失便，三可憂；

translations.literal: Strongpoints and passes, what is easy or hard to attack or defend—these should be planned with frontier generals. Now measures for lands beyond the Yellow River frontier are decided only in the court hall. If the barbarians suddenly strike the border, response will be awkward—this is the third worry.
translations.idiomatic: Which strongpoints matter, and what is easy or hard to attack or defend, should be planned with frontier generals. Now plans for lands beyond the river frontier are cut off in the court hall alone. If the barbarians suddenly strike the border, response will be clumsy. That is the third worry.

sentences.zh: 自脩好以來，山川形勝，兵戍滿虛，虜皆悉之，賊掠諸州，調發在旬朔外，其系累人畜在旦夕內，比王師至則虜已歸，寇能久留，役亦轉廣，四可憂；

translations.literal: Since the peace pact, the terrain's advantages and whether garrisons are full or empty—the barbarians know them all. When raiders plunder the prefectures, mobilization lies beyond ten or fifteen days, while their captives and livestock are taken within a day or two. By the time the imperial army arrives the barbarians are already gone; raiders cannot long remain, yet the labor of campaigns grows ever greater—this is the fourth worry.
translations.idiomatic: Since the peace pact the barbarians have learned every advantage of the terrain and every full or empty garrison. When raiders plunder the prefectures, mobilization takes more than ten or fifteen days, while captives and livestock are seized within a day or two. By the time the imperial army arrives the barbarians are already gone. Raiders cannot stay long, yet the burden of campaigns grows ever greater. That is the fourth worry.

sentences.zh: 北狄西戎，素相攻討，故邊無虞，今回鶻不市馬，若與吐蕃結約解仇，則將臣閉壁憚戰，邊人拱手受禍，五可憂。

translations.literal: Northern barbarians and the western Rong have always attacked one another, so the frontier had no trouble. Now the Uyghurs do not trade horses. If they form a pact with Tibet and end their enmity, generals and ministers will shut their walls and fear battle, while border people will fold their arms and suffer disaster—this is the fifth worry.
translations.idiomatic: Northern barbarians and the western Rong have always fought one another, so the frontier had been untroubled. Now the Uyghurs no longer trade horses. If they make a pact with Tibet and end their feud, generals and ministers will shut themselves behind walls and fear battle, while border people will stand by helplessly and suffer. That is the fifth worry.

sentences.zh: 又淮西吳少陽垂死，可乘其變，諸道興發，役且十倍。

translations.literal: Moreover Wu Shaoyang of Huai West is near death—we can seize on that change. If all circuits are mobilized, the corvée will increase tenfold.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Wu Shaoyang of Huai West is near death, and we can seize on that change. If all circuits are mobilized, the corvée will increase tenfold.

sentences.zh: 臣謂宜聽其婚，使守蕃禮，所謂三利也；

translations.literal: Your servant holds that you should grant the marriage and have them observe frontier ritual—what is called the three benefits.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that you should grant the marriage and have them observe frontier ritual. These are what are called the three benefits.

sentences.zh: 和親則烽燧不驚，城堞可治，盛兵以畜力，積粟以固軍，一也；

translations.literal: With marriage alliance, beacon fires will not be startled, walls and parapets can be repaired, troops can be massed to store strength, and grain hoarded to solidify the army—this is the first.
translations.idiomatic: With a marriage alliance, beacon fires will not flare in alarm, walls and parapets can be repaired, troops can be massed to build strength, and grain stored to steady the army. That is the first benefit.

sentences.zh: 既無北顧憂，可南事淮右，申令於垂盡之寇，二也；

translations.literal: Once there is no worry to the north, you can turn south on Huai Right and proclaim orders against a dying foe—this is the second.
translations.idiomatic: Once there is no worry to the north, you can turn south against Huai Right and proclaim orders against a dying foe. That is the second benefit.

sentences.zh: 北虜恃我戚，則西戎怨愈深，內不得寧，國家坐受其安，寇掠長息，三也。

translations.literal: When the northern barbarians rely on our kin ties, western Rong resentment grows deeper; within they cannot be at peace, while the state sits in security and raiding dies down for long stretches—this is the third.
translations.idiomatic: When the northern barbarians rely on our kinship, western Rong resentment grows deeper and they cannot be at peace within, while the state sits secure and raiding subsides for long stretches. That is the third benefit.

sentences.zh: 今舍三利，取五憂，甚非計。

translations.literal: Now to abandon three benefits and take up five worries is very poor planning.
translations.idiomatic: To abandon three benefits and take up five worries is very poor planning.

sentences.zh: 或曰降主費多，臣謂不然。

translations.literal: Some say marrying a princess costs too much; your servant says this is not so.
translations.idiomatic: Some say that marrying off a princess costs too much. I say that is not so.

sentences.zh: 我三分天下賦，以一事邊。

translations.literal: We assign a third of the empire's tax levy to one frontier matter.
translations.idiomatic: We devote a third of the empire's tax revenue to a single frontier matter.

sentences.zh: 今東南大縣賦歲二十萬緡，以一縣賦為婚貲，非損寡得大乎？

translations.literal: Today a great southeastern county yields two hundred thousand strings in tax yearly—to use one county's levy as bride-price is not trading little to gain much?
translations.idiomatic: A large southeastern county now yields two hundred thousand strings in tax each year. To use one county's levy as bride-price—is that not trading little to gain much?

sentences.zh: 今惜婚費不與，假如王師北征，兵非三萬、騎五千不能捍且馳也。

translations.literal: If today you begrudge bride-price and refuse, supposing the imperial army marches north, you would need no fewer than thirty thousand infantry and five thousand cavalry merely to hold the line and ride in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: If you begrudge the bride-price today and refuse, suppose the imperial army marches north. You would need at least thirty thousand foot soldiers and five thousand cavalry just to hold the line and pursue.

sentences.zh: 又如保十全之勝，一歲輒罷，其饋餉供擬，豈止一縣賦哉？」

translations.literal: Again, even a victory like Pei Quanzhong's is ended within a year—its supplies and provisions, can they be limited to one county's levy?
translations.idiomatic: Again, even a victory like Pei Quanzhong's ends within a year. Can its supplies and provisions be limited to one county's levy?

sentences.zh: 帝不聽。

translations.literal: The emperor did not heed him.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not heed him.

sentences.zh: ◎回鶻下

translations.literal: ◎ Uyghurs, Part Two
translations.idiomatic: ◎ The Uyghurs, Part Two

sentences.zh: 回鶻之請昏，有司度費當五百萬，帝方內討強節度，故遣宗正少卿李誠、太常博士殷侑往諭不可。

translations.literal: The Uyghurs' request for marriage: the authorities estimated the cost at five million. The emperor was just then suppressing powerful military commissioners inwardly, so he sent Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan Li Cheng and Academician of the Court of Sacrificial Worship Yin You to explain that it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: When the Uyghurs requested marriage, the authorities estimated the cost at five million. The emperor was just then suppressing powerful military commissioners at home, so he sent Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Clan Li Cheng and Academician of the Court of Sacrificial Worship Yin You to explain that it could not be granted.

sentences.zh: 穆宗立，回鶻又使合達幹等來固求昏，許之。

translations.literal: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, the Uyghurs again sent Heda Gan and others to press hard for marriage, and he granted it.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Muzong took the throne, the Uyghurs again sent Heda Gan and others to press hard for marriage, and he agreed.

sentences.zh: 俄而可汗死，使者臨冊所嗣為登啰羽錄沒蜜施句主毗伽崇德可汗。

translations.literal: Before long the qaghan died. Envoys came to invest the successor as Dengluo Yulu Mo Mishe Ju Zhu Bilge Chongde Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the qaghan died. Envoys came to invest the successor as Dengluo Yulu Mo Mishe Ju Zhu Bilge Chongde Qaghan.

sentences.zh: 可汗已立，遣伊難珠、句錄、都督思結等以葉護公主來逆女，部渠二千人，納馬二萬、橐它千。

translations.literal: Once the qaghan was established, he sent Yinanzhu, Julu, Protector-General Sijie, and others with Princess Yehu to come and receive the bride. Their chiefs numbered two thousand men; they presented twenty thousand horses and a thousand camels.
translations.idiomatic: Once the qaghan was enthroned, he sent Yinanzhu, Julu, Protector-General Sijie, and others with Princess Yehu to come and receive the bride. Two thousand chiefs came with them, presenting twenty thousand horses and a thousand camels.

sentences.zh: 四夷之使中國，其眾未嘗多此。

translations.literal: Among envoys of the four barbarians coming to China, their numbers had never been so great.
translations.idiomatic: Among envoys of the four barbarians coming to China, their numbers had never been so great.

sentences.zh: 詔許五百人至長安，余留太原。

translations.literal: An edict allowed five hundred men to reach Chang'an; the rest remained at Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed five hundred men to proceed to Chang'an; the rest remained at Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 詔以太和公主下降。

translations.literal: An edict sent down Princess Taihe in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent Princess Taihe down in marriage.

sentences.zh: 主，憲宗女也。

translations.literal: The princess was a daughter of Emperor Xianzong.
translations.idiomatic: The princess was a daughter of Emperor Xianzong.

sentences.zh: 帝為主建府，以左金吾衛大將軍胡證、光祿卿李憲持節護送，太府卿李說為昏禮使，冊拜主為仁孝端麗明智上壽可敦，告於廟，天子禦通化門餞主，群臣班辭於道。

translations.literal: The emperor built a mansion for the princess. He sent Left Golden Crow Guard General Hu Zheng and Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Li Xian bearing credentials to escort her, and Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Li Yue as marriage envoy. He invested the princess as Khatun Renxiao Duanli Mingzhi Shangshou and announced this at the ancestral temple. The Son of Heaven went out to Tonghua Gate to bid her farewell, and the ministers took their leave in ranks along the road.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor built a residence for the princess and sent Left Golden Crow Guard General Hu Zheng and Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Li Xian with credentials to escort her. Director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury Li Yue served as marriage envoy. The princess was invested as Khatun Renxiao Duanli Mingzhi Shangshou, and the announcement was made at the ancestral temple. The Son of Heaven went out to Tonghua Gate to bid her farewell, and the ministers took their leave in ranks along the road.

sentences.zh: 公主出塞，距回鶻牙百里，可汗欲先與主由間道私見，胡證不可，虜人曰：「昔鹹安公主行之。」

translations.literal: The princess left the frontier. A hundred li from the Uyghur royal camp, the qaghan wished first to meet the princess privately by a bypath. Hu Zheng refused. The barbarians said: "In former times Princess Xian'an did this.
translations.idiomatic: The princess crossed the frontier. A hundred li from the Uyghur royal camp the qaghan wished to meet the princess privately first by a side path. Hu Zheng refused. The barbarians said, "Princess Xian'an did this in former times.

sentences.zh: 證曰：「天子詔我送公主授可汗，今未見，不可先也。」

translations.literal: Zheng said: "The Son of Heaven ordered me to escort the princess and hand her to the qaghan. I have not yet seen him; I cannot go first."
translations.idiomatic: Zheng said, "The Son of Heaven ordered me to escort the princess and deliver her to the qaghan. I have not yet seen him, so I cannot go ahead."

sentences.zh: 乃止。

translations.literal: Thereupon they stopped.
translations.idiomatic: They then desisted.

sentences.zh: 於是可汗升樓坐，東向，下設毳幔以居公主，請襲胡衣，以一姆侍出，西向拜已，退即次，被可敦服，絳通裾大襦，冠金冠，前後銳，復出拜已，乃升曲輿，九相分負，右旋於廷者九，降輿升樓，與可汗聯坐，東向，群臣以次謁。

translations.literal: Thereupon the qaghan ascended a tower and sat facing east. Below he set felt curtains for the princess to dwell in. She was asked to don barbarian dress. A nurse attended her out; she bowed westward and withdrew to her place. She donned khatun garb—a crimson robe with a full skirt and a golden crown sharp fore and aft. She came out and bowed again, then mounted a curved litter. Nine chancellors bore it in turn; they circled right nine times in the court, descended, and ascended the tower to sit beside the qaghan facing east. The ministers paid their respects in order.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan then ascended a tower and sat facing east. Below, felt curtains were set for the princess. She was asked to wear barbarian dress. A nurse attended her as she came out, bowed westward, and withdrew to her place. She put on khatun dress: a crimson robe with a full skirt and a golden crown pointed fore and aft. She came out and bowed again, then mounted a curved litter. Nine chancellors bore it in turn, circling right nine times in the court. She descended, ascended the tower, and sat beside the qaghan facing east while the ministers paid their respects in order.

sentences.zh: 可敦亦自建牙，以二相出入帳中。

translations.literal: The khatun also established her own royal camp, with two chancellors entering and leaving her tent.
translations.idiomatic: The khatun also established her own royal camp, with two chancellors entering and leaving her tent.

sentences.zh: 證等歸，可敦大宴，悲啼眷慕。

translations.literal: When Zheng and the others returned, the khatun held a great feast, weeping sadly in longing and affection.
translations.idiomatic: When Zheng and the others returned, the khatun held a great feast, weeping in longing and affection.

sentences.zh: 可汗厚贈使者。

translations.literal: The qaghan richly rewarded the envoys.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan richly rewarded the envoys.

sentences.zh: 是時，裴度方伐幽、鎮，回鶻使渠將李義節以兵三千佐天子平河北，議者懲艾前患，不聽，兵已及豐州，使者厚賜乃去。

translations.literal: At this time Pei Du was campaigning against You and Zhen. The Uyghur envoy and tribal general Li Yijie came with three thousand troops to help the Son of Heaven pacify Hebei. Critics, mindful of past troubles, did not consent. The troops had already reached Fengzhou before the envoys were richly rewarded and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Pei Du was campaigning against You and Zhen. The Uyghur envoy and tribal general Li Yijie came with three thousand troops to help the Son of Heaven pacify Hebei. Critics, mindful of past troubles, would not agree. The troops had already reached Fengzhou before the envoys were richly rewarded and sent away.

sentences.zh: 敬宗即位之年，可汗死，其弟曷薩特勒立，遣使者冊為愛登裏羅汨沒密施合毗伽昭禮可汗，賜幣十二車。

translations.literal: In the year Emperor Jingzong took the throne the qaghan died. His younger brother Esar Tegin succeeded and sent envoys to invest him as Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Bilge Zhaoli Qaghan, granting twelve cartloads of gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the year Emperor Jingzong took the throne the qaghan died. His younger brother Esar Tegin succeeded. Envoys were sent to invest him as Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Bilge Zhaoli Qaghan and to grant twelve cartloads of gifts.

sentences.zh: 文宗初，又賜馬直絹五十萬。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Emperor Wenzong's reign they again granted five hundred thousand bolts of silk as horse price.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Emperor Wenzong's reign they again granted five hundred thousand bolts of silk as payment for horses.

sentences.zh: 大和六年，可汗為其下所殺，從子胡特勒立，使者來告。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of the Dahe era the qaghan was killed by his subordinates. His nephew Hu Tegin succeeded, and envoys came to report it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of the Dahe era the qaghan was killed by his subordinates. His nephew Hu Tegin succeeded, and envoys came to report it.

sentences.zh: 明年，遣左驍衛將軍唐弘實與嗣澤王溶持節冊為愛登裏羅汨沒蜜施合句錄毗伽彰信可汗。

translations.literal: The next year they sent Left Xiaowei Guard General Tang Hongshi and Prince of Size Rong bearing credentials to invest him as Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Julu Bilge Zhangxin Qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they sent Left Xiaowei Guard General Tang Hongshi and Prince of Size Rong bearing credentials to invest him as Edgü Bilge Qutlugh Alp Julu Bilge Zhangxin Qaghan.

sentences.zh: 開成四年，其相掘羅勿作難，引沙陀共攻可汗，可汗自殺，國人立{廠盍}馺特勒為可汗。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Kaicheng era his chancellor Juoluowu made trouble, bringing in the Shatuo to attack the qaghan together. The qaghan killed himself. The people enthroned Hesa Tegin as qaghan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of the Kaicheng era his chancellor Juoluowu rebelled, bringing in the Shatuo to attack the qaghan together. The qaghan killed himself. The people enthroned Hesa Tegin as qaghan.

sentences.zh: 方歲饑，遂疫，又大雪，羊、馬多死，未及命。

translations.literal: Just then there was famine, then pestilence, and again heavy snow; sheep and horses died in great numbers. Before an investiture could be sent.
translations.idiomatic: Famine had just struck, then pestilence, and then heavy snow. Sheep and horses died in great numbers. Before an investiture could be sent.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，以嗣澤王溶臨告，乃知其國亂。

translations.literal: Emperor Wuzong took the throne. Prince of Size Rong came to announce the situation in person, and only then did they learn that the state was in disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wuzong took the throne. Prince of Size Rong came in person to announce the situation, and only then did the court learn that the state was in disorder.

sentences.zh: 俄而渠長句錄莫賀與黠戛斯合騎十萬攻回鶻城，殺可汗，誅掘羅勿，焚其牙，諸部潰其相馺職與厖特勒十五部奔葛邏祿，殘眾入吐蕃、安西。

translations.literal: Before long the tribal chief Julu Mohe joined with the Kirghiz in a combined force of one hundred thousand horsemen to attack the Uyghur capital. They killed the qaghan, executed Juoluowu, burned the royal camp, and the tribes broke apart. Chancellor Sazhi and Tegin Mang with fifteen tribes fled to the Qarluqs; the remnant people entered Tibet and Anxi.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the tribal chief Julu Mohe joined the Kirghiz in a combined force of one hundred thousand horsemen to attack the Uyghur capital. They killed the qaghan, executed Juoluowu, and burned the royal camp. The tribes broke apart. Chancellor Sazhi and Tegin Mang fled to the Qarluqs with fifteen tribes, while the remnant people entered Tibet and Anxi.

sentences.zh: 於是，可汗牙部十三姓奉烏介特勒為可汗，南保錯子山。

translations.literal: Thereupon thirteen clans of the qaghan's royal guard enthroned Tegin Wujie as qaghan and withdrew south to guard Cuozi Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon thirteen clans of the qaghan's royal guard enthroned Tegin Wujie as qaghan and withdrew south to hold Cuozi Mountain.

sentences.zh: 黠戛斯已破回鶻，得太和公主；

translations.literal: The Kirghiz had already broken the Uyghurs and taken Princess Taihe.
translations.idiomatic: The Kirghiz had already defeated the Uyghurs and taken Princess Taihe.

sentences.zh: 又自以李陵後，與唐同宗，故遣使者達幹奉主來歸。

translations.literal: They also considered themselves descendants of Li Ling and of the same clan as Tang, so they sent the envoy Dagan to escort the princess back in submission.
translations.idiomatic: They also considered themselves descendants of Li Ling and kin to Tang, so they sent the envoy Dagan to escort the princess home.

sentences.zh: 烏介怒，追擊達幹殺之，劫主南度磧，邊人大恐。

translations.literal: Wujie was enraged. He pursued, attacked, and killed Dagan, seized the princess, and crossed the desert southward. Border people were greatly afraid.
translations.idiomatic: Wujie was enraged. He pursued Dagan, killed him, seized the princess, and crossed the desert southward. The border people were terrified.

sentences.zh: 進攻天德城，振武節度使劉沔屯雲伽關拒卻之。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack Tiande city. Zhenwu Military Commissioner Liu Mian encamped at Yunguan Pass and repelled him.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to attack Tiande city. Zhenwu Military Commissioner Liu Mian encamped at Yunguan Pass and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 宰相李德裕建言：「回鶻曩有功，今饑且亂，可汗無歸，不可擊，宜遣使者贍安之。」

translations.literal: Chief Minister Li Deyu advised: "The Uyghurs once rendered service. Now they are hungry and in disorder, and the qaghan has nowhere to return. They should not be attacked. Envoys should be sent to support and reassure them.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Minister Li Deyu advised, "The Uyghurs once rendered service. Now they are hungry and in disorder, and the qaghan has nowhere to return. They should not be attacked. Envoys should be sent to support and reassure them.

sentences.zh: 帝用兵部郎中李拭行邊刺狀。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Li Shi of the Ministry of War to tour the frontier and report conditions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Li Shi of the Ministry of War to tour the frontier and report on conditions.

sentences.zh: 於是，其相赤心與王子嗢沒斯、特勒那頡啜將其部欲自歸，而公主亦遣使者來言烏介已立，因請命。

translations.literal: Thereupon his chancellor Chixin and Princes Wumosi and Tegin Naxiechuo wished to bring their tribes to submit on their own. The princess also sent envoys to say that Wujie had already been enthroned and to request an appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon his chancellor Chixin and Princes Wumosi and Tegin Naxiechuo wished to bring their tribes to submit on their own. The princess also sent envoys to say that Wujie had already been enthroned and to request an appointment.

sentences.zh: 又大臣頡幹伽思等表假振武居公主、可汗。

translations.literal: Moreover the great ministers Niegansisi and others memorialized asking to borrow Zhenwu for the princess and qaghan to dwell in.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the great ministers Niegansisi and others memorialized asking to let the princess and qaghan stay at Zhenwu.

sentences.zh: 帝乃詔右金吾衛大將軍王會持節慰撫其眾，輸糧二萬斛，不許借振武，令中人好語開諭；

translations.literal: The emperor then ordered Right Golden Crow Guard General Wang Hui bearing credentials to comfort and reassure their people, and sent twenty thousand bushels of grain. He did not allow them to borrow Zhenwu and ordered eunuchs to speak kindly and instruct them.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then ordered Right Golden Crow Guard General Wang Hui bearing credentials to comfort and reassure their people and sent twenty thousand bushels of grain. He would not let them stay at Zhenwu and ordered eunuchs to speak kindly and instruct them.

sentences.zh: 又詔使者持冊往，潛稽其行，須變。

translations.literal: He also ordered envoys to go bearing patents of appointment, secretly to watch their conduct and wait for a change.
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered envoys to go bearing patents of appointment, secretly to watch their conduct and wait for a change.

sentences.zh: 明年，回鶻奉主至漠南，入雲、朔，剽橫水，殺掠甚眾，轉側天德、振武間，盜畜牧自如。

translations.literal: The next year the Uyghurs escorted the princess to the south of the desert. They entered Yun and Shuo, raided Hengshui, killed and plundered in great numbers, shifted between Tiande and Zhenwu, and stole livestock as they pleased.
translations.idiomatic: The next year the Uyghurs escorted the princess to the south of the desert. They entered Yun and Shuo, raided Hengshui, killed and plundered in great numbers, shifted between Tiande and Zhenwu, and stole livestock as they pleased.

sentences.zh: 乃召諸道兵合討。

translations.literal: The court then summoned troops from all circuits for a joint campaign.
translations.idiomatic: The court then summoned troops from all circuits for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 嗢沒斯以赤心奸桀，難得要領，即密約天德戍將田牟，誘赤心斬帳下。

translations.literal: Wumosi, finding Chixin treacherous and violent and hard to pin down, secretly arranged with Tiande garrison commander Tian Mou to lure Chixin and behead him in the tent.
translations.idiomatic: Wumosi found Chixin treacherous and violent and hard to pin down. He secretly arranged with Tiande garrison commander Tian Mou to lure Chixin and behead him in the tent.

sentences.zh: 那頡啜收赤心眾七千帳東走振武、大同，因室韋、黑沙南窺幽州，節度使張仲武破之，悉得其眾。

translations.literal: Naxiechuo gathered Chixin's seven thousand tents and fled east toward Zhenwu and Datong. Passing through the Shiwei and Black Sands he spied south on Youzhou. Military Commissioner Zhang Zhongwu defeated him and took all his followers.
translations.idiomatic: Naxiechuo gathered Chixin's seven thousand tents and fled east toward Zhenwu and Datong. Passing through the Shiwei and Black Sands he spied south on Youzhou. Military Commissioner Zhang Zhongwu defeated him and took all his followers.

sentences.zh: 那頡啜走，烏介執而殺之。

translations.literal: Naxiechuo fled. Wujie seized and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Naxiechuo fled. Wujie seized and killed him.

sentences.zh: 然烏介兵尚強，號十萬，駐牙大同北閭門山。

translations.literal: Yet Wujie's troops were still strong, numbering a hundred thousand in claim. He encamped at Lümen Mountain north of Datong.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Wujie's troops were still strong, claiming a hundred thousand men. He encamped at Lümen Mountain north of Datong.

sentences.zh: 而特勒厖俱遮、阿敦寧等凡四部，及將軍曹磨你眾三萬，因仲武降，嗢沒斯亦附使者送款。

translations.literal: But Tegin Mangjuzhe, Aduning, and four tribes in all, together with General Cao Moni and thirty thousand followers, submitted through Zhongwu. Wumosi also attached himself to the envoys and sent pledges of loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: But Tegin Mangjuzhe, Aduning, and four tribes in all, together with General Cao Moni and thirty thousand followers, submitted through Zhongwu. Wumosi also sent pledges of loyalty through the envoys.

sentences.zh: 帝欲使助可汗復國，而可汗已攻雲州，劉沔與戰，敗績。

translations.literal: The emperor wished to have them help the qaghan restore his state, but the qaghan had already attacked Yunzhou. Liu Mian fought him and was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor wished to have them help the qaghan restore his state, but the qaghan had already attacked Yunzhou. Liu Mian fought him and was defeated.

sentences.zh: 嗢沒斯率三部及特勒、大酋二千騎詣振武降。

translations.literal: Wumosi led three tribes together with tegins and great chiefs—two thousand horsemen—and came to Zhenwu to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Wumosi led three tribes together with tegins and great chiefs—two thousand horsemen—and came to Zhenwu to submit.

sentences.zh: 詔拜嗢沒斯為右金吾衛大將軍，爵懷化郡王，以天德為歸義軍，即拜歸義軍使；

translations.literal: An edict appointed Wumosi Right Golden Crow Guard General and enfeoffed him as Prince of Huaihua Commandery. Tiande was made the Guiyi Army, and he was immediately appointed its commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Wumosi Right Golden Crow Guard General and enfeoffed him as Prince of Huaihua Commandery. Tiande was made the Guiyi Army, and he was immediately appointed its commissioner.

sentences.zh: 阿歷支寧邊郡公，習勿啜昌化郡公，烏羅思寧朔郡公，並為冠軍大將軍、左威衛大將軍；

translations.literal: Alizhi was made Duke of Ningbian Commandery, Xiwuchuo Duke of Changhua Commandery, and Wuluosi Duke of Ningshuo Commandery. All were made Champion Generals and Left Weiwu Guard Generals.
translations.idiomatic: Alizhi was made Duke of Ningbian Commandery, Xiwuchuo Duke of Changhua Commandery, and Wuluosi Duke of Ningshuo Commandery. All were made Champion Generals and Left Weiwu Guard Generals.

sentences.zh: 愛邪勿寧塞郡公，為右領軍大將軍。

translations.literal: Aiyiewu was made Duke of Ningsai Commandery and appointed Right Lingjun Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: Aiyiewu was made Duke of Ningsai Commandery and appointed Right Lingjun Guard General.

sentences.zh: 加賜嗢沒斯牙旗、豹尾、刀器諸物，給其屬冠帶。

translations.literal: They further granted Wumosi a royal-camp banner, leopard tails, blades, and other objects, and gave his followers caps and belts.
translations.idiomatic: They further granted Wumosi a royal-camp banner, leopard tails, blades, and other objects, and gave his followers caps and belts.

sentences.zh: 詔宰相德裕采秦、漢以來興殊俗、忠效卓異者凡三十人，為《異域歸忠傳》寵賜之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chief Minister Deyu to select thirty men since Qin and Han who had raised foreign peoples and shown outstanding loyalty and service, and compose the "Record of Foreign Lands Returning in Loyalty" to honor and bestow upon them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Chief Minister Deyu to select thirty men since Qin and Han who had raised foreign peoples and shown outstanding loyalty and service, and compose the "Record of Foreign Lands Returning in Loyalty" to honor and bestow upon them.

sentences.zh: 嗢沒斯請留族太原，率昆弟為天子捍邊，帝命劉沔為列舍雲、朔間處其家。

translations.literal: Wumosi asked to leave his clan at Taiyuan and lead his brothers to defend the frontier for the Son of Heaven. The emperor ordered Liu Mian to arrange dwellings for their families between Yun and Shuo.
translations.idiomatic: Wumosi asked to leave his clan at Taiyuan and lead his brothers to defend the frontier for the Son of Heaven. The emperor ordered Liu Mian to arrange dwellings for their families between Yun and Shuo.

sentences.zh: 可汗遣使者藉兵欲還故廷，且假天德城，帝不許。

translations.literal: The qaghan sent envoys to borrow troops, wishing to return to his former royal camp, and also to borrow Tiande city. The emperor did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan sent envoys to borrow troops, wishing to return to his former royal camp, and also to borrow Tiande city. The emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 可汗恚，進略大同川，轉戰攻雲州，刺史嬰壁不敢出。

translations.literal: The qaghan was resentful. He advanced to raid Datong River valley, shifted battle to attack Yunzhou, and the prefect shut his walls and dared not come out.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan was resentful. He advanced to raid the Datong River valley, shifted battle to attack Yunzhou, and the prefect shut his walls and dared not come out.

sentences.zh: 詔益發諸鎮兵屯太原以北。

translations.literal: An edict ordered additional troops from all military commissions to be stationed north of Taiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered additional troops from all military commissions to be stationed north of Taiyuan.

sentences.zh: 嗢沒斯等既朝，皆賜李氏，名嗢沒斯曰思忠，阿歷支曰思貞，習勿啜曰思義，烏羅思曰思禮；

translations.literal: After Wumosi and the others had come to court, all were granted the surname Li. Wumosi was named Sizhong, Alizhi Sizhen, Xiwuchuo Siyi, and Wuluosi Sili.
translations.idiomatic: After Wumosi and the others had come to court, all were granted the surname Li. Wumosi was named Sizhong, Alizhi Sizhen, Xiwuchuo Siyi, and Wuluosi Sili.

sentences.zh: 愛邪勿曰弘順，即拜歸義軍副使。

translations.literal: Aiyiewu was named Hongshun and immediately appointed deputy commissioner of the Guiyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: Aiyiewu was named Hongshun and immediately appointed deputy commissioner of the Guiyi Army.

sentences.zh: 於是，詔劉沔為回鶻南面招撫使，張仲武東面招撫使，思忠為河西党項都將、西南面招討使，沔營雁門。

translations.literal: Thereupon Liu Mian was ordered as Uyghur Southern Pacification Commissioner, Zhang Zhongwu as Eastern Pacification Commissioner, and Sizhong as Hexi Tangut Commander and Southwestern Campaign Commissioner. Mian encamped at Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Liu Mian was made Uyghur Southern Pacification Commissioner, Zhang Zhongwu Eastern Pacification Commissioner, and Sizhong Hexi Tangut Commander and Southwestern Campaign Commissioner. Mian encamped at Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 又詔銀州刺史何清朝、蔚州刺史契通，以蕃、渾兵出振武，與沔、仲武合，稍逼回鶻。

translations.literal: An edict also ordered Yinzhou Prefect He Qingchao and Weizhou Prefect Qitong to lead Fan and Hun troops out from Zhenwu, join Mian and Zhongwu, and gradually press the Uyghurs.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered Yinzhou Prefect He Qingchao and Weizhou Prefect Qitong to lead Fan and Hun troops out from Zhenwu, join Mian and Zhongwu, and gradually press the Uyghurs.

sentences.zh: 思忠數深入諭降其下。

translations.literal: Sizhong repeatedly went deep in to instruct and win over their subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: Sizhong repeatedly went deep into their territory to persuade their followers to submit.

sentences.zh: 沔分沙陀兵益思忠，河中軍以騎五百益弘順。

translations.literal: Mian detached Shatuo troops to reinforce Sizhong. The Hezhong army sent five hundred cavalry to reinforce Hongshun.
translations.idiomatic: Mian detached Shatuo troops to reinforce Sizhong. The Hezhong army sent five hundred cavalry to reinforce Hongshun.

sentences.zh: 沔進次雲州，思忠屯保大柵率河中、陳許兵與回鶻戰，敗之。

translations.literal: Mian advanced and encamped at Yunzhou. Sizhong encamped at Baoda Stockade, led Hezhong and Chenxu troops to fight the Uyghurs, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Mian advanced and encamped at Yunzhou. Sizhong encamped at Baoda Stockade, led Hezhong and Chenxu troops against the Uyghurs, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 明年，又為弘順所破。

translations.literal: The next year they were defeated again by Hongshun.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they were defeated again by Hongshun.

sentences.zh: 沔與天德行營副使石雄料勁騎及沙陀、契等雜虜，夜出雲州，走馬邑，抵安眾塞，逢虜，與戰破之。

translations.literal: Mian and Tiande Field Deputy Commissioner Shi Xiong selected elite cavalry together with Shatuo, Qi, and other mixed barbarians. By night they left Yunzhou, galloped to Mayi, reached Anzhong Pass, met the barbarians, fought, and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Mian and Tiande Field Deputy Commissioner Shi Xiong selected elite cavalry together with Shatuo, Qi, and other mixed barbarian forces. By night they left Yunzhou, galloped to Mayi, reached Anzhong Pass, met the barbarians, fought, and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 烏介方薄振武，雄馳入，夜穴壘出鏖兵，烏介驚，引去，雄追北至殺胡山，烏介被創走。

translations.literal: Wujie was then pressing Zhenwu. Xiong galloped in, by night tunneled through the ramparts and burst out to fight fiercely. Wujie was startled and withdrew. Xiong pursued north to Mount Sha Hu. Wujie was wounded and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Wujie was then pressing Zhenwu. Xiong galloped in, tunneled through the ramparts by night, and burst out to fight fiercely. Wujie was startled and withdrew. Xiong pursued north to Mount Sha Hu. Wujie was wounded and fled.

sentences.zh: 雄遇公主，奉主還，降特勒以下眾數萬，盡收輜帑及所賜詔書。

translations.literal: Xiong met the princess, escorted her back, and received the submission of several tens of thousands below the tegin rank. He recovered all baggage and the edicts that had been granted.
translations.idiomatic: Xiong met the princess, escorted her back, and received the submission of several tens of thousands below the tegin rank. He recovered all baggage and the edicts that had been granted.

sentences.zh: 可汗收所餘往依黑車子，詔弘順、清朝窮躡。

translations.literal: The qaghan gathered what remained and went to rely on the Black Cart tribe. An edict ordered Hongshun and Qingchao to pursue them to the end.
translations.idiomatic: The qaghan gathered what remained and went to rely on the Black Cart tribe. An edict ordered Hongshun and Qingchao to pursue them relentlessly.

sentences.zh: 弘順厚啖黑車子以利，募殺烏介。

translations.literal: Hongshun richly fed the Black Cart tribe with profit and recruited them to kill Wujie.
translations.idiomatic: Hongshun richly rewarded the Black Cart tribe and recruited them to kill Wujie.

sentences.zh: 初，從可汗亡者既不能軍，往往詣幽州降，留者皆饑寒痕夷，裁數千。

translations.literal: At first those who followed the qaghan in flight could no longer fight as an army. Many went to Youzhou to submit. Those who remained were all hungry, cold, and wretched—only a few thousand.
translations.idiomatic: At first those who followed the qaghan in flight could no longer fight as an army. Many went to Youzhou to submit. Those who remained were hungry, cold, and wretched—only a few thousand.

sentences.zh: 黑車子幸其殘，即殺烏介。
